Sheet-vs-font: the sheet's 'EM' (Series E modified) words are set wider than the FHWA Series E modified font at plus0 (NEXT 485 against 461); each letter is drawn from the font and placed at the sheet's own letter positions (measured), so the word spans the stated width.
